scientific_integrity: Analytical finite-graph theorem with exact boundary treatment; finite rational checks corroborate but do not prove arbitrary graph orders. No independent audit.
scientific_limitations: Two initially uniform camps, intra-camp attractive and inter-camp repulsive sign-biregularity, fixed strict confidence and synchronous updates only; possible unindexed equivalent block reduction.
title: Sharp cross-contact persistence transition in two-camp repulsive bounded-confidence networks
